issues.title: Accented characters turn into dashes
issues.maintainer_comment: This is by design: accents are dropped unless you pass `transliterate: true`, which gives `cafe-au-lait`. It's off by default so slugs stay predictable for scripts that don't transliterate well. Closing, but happy to make the README clearer.

issues.title: Blog crashes when a post title is only emoji
issues.body: Someone posted a title that was just 🎉🎉🎉 and our blog's build fell over. We use tiny-slug 1.2.0 to make the URLs. The error said something about `toLowerCase` but I didn't keep the log, sorry. Happens every time with that post.

issues.title: Slugs lose accented letters (é, ü, ñ)
issues.body: Titles in French and Spanish come out broken: `Crème Brûlée` becomes `cr-me-br-l-e` and `Mañana` becomes `ma-ana`. This makes our URLs unreadable. Is this a bug?

issues.title: Custom separator leaves underscores at the start and end
issues.body:
With `separator: '_'`, `slugify('Hello World!', { separator: '_' })` returns `hello_world_` with a trailing underscore, and `slugify('¡Hola!', { separator: '_' })` returns `_hola_`. With the default `-` it's fine.

There's no test covering custom separators. Could someone add a test that pins this down, so whoever fixes it can see when it's done?

issues.title: README example for truncation doesn't work
issues.body: The README says `slugify('A very long title for a blog post', { maxLen: 20 })` returns `'a-very-long-title'`, but I get the whole thing back: `a-very-long-title-for-a-blog-post`. Am I doing something wrong?

issues.title: fileSlug includes folder names on Windows
issues.body: On my Windows laptop, `fileSlug(path.join('posts', 'Hello World.md'))` returns `posts-hello-world` instead of `hello-world`. Our Linux CI is green, so maybe it's something about my setup? Node 22, Windows 11.
